searchText: We'd still perform a few more tests on devnet-2, but in general we're waiting on launching devnet-3 for the next round of testing. The specs doc can be found here: https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/pectra-devnet-3 Open topics: - 7702 changes, also flagged here: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/718596092828057631/1272489434134085743 - Execution spec tests release needed, cc <@892053833121923094> <@755913785620824175> - Builder spec updates, unsure who's owning this right now, cc <@539495253418180618> <@694014391288332358> As always, let me or Barnabas know if there's a missing PR or you see outdated information. Wait a minute, devnet-2 is more than 90000 slots old already. https://dora.pectra-devnet-2.ethpandaops.io/ ugh, sorry named it wrong. its devnet-3 i'm talking about, ill fix it Monday... updated doc 😄 ethereumjs missing on all pairs? also dora back to showing very little history on proposer name filtering Dora is re-indexing with a new db. cc <@808969530608451584>. Might take a few hours before all epoch are done. ethjs is expected to have issues with block proposals as per <@792822129019584562> said last week on acd. We plan to have ethjs around to follow the chain in the future, and rely less on their block proposals should be fixed now 🙂 but as barnabas said, the db is not complete yet, so don't rely on historical data yet. should be ready by tomorrow correct, if network load is low, ethjs should also be proposing else its always in a mode of catchup unless we plan to plug a rust evm in future 7702 tests are ready for devnet-3, we just need a transition tool to fill them, it could be from any client, whichever is ready first 👍 I am working on this right now, will report when I think it's done 🙂 In the tests you have written, if a evm opcode hits a delegated account, is then the account it is delegated to also added to the warm addresses? It should already be in the warm addresses list, the moment it's read from the delegated accounts list Ah no, I mean when evm hits an `extcodesize` for instance so `extcodesize` to the code address that the account was delageted to? yes it's cold until `extcodesize` Might be worth mentioning that the only time when the code account could be warm is if the address is in the access list: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/blob/4aaf7ed3b219caba6326a3ac39af022e5a82160b/tests/prague/eip7702_set_code_tx/test_gas.py#L628-L629 Getting missed slots on teku-erigon pair, any ideas? cc <@&836981489430036500> ``` 2024-08-12 20:07:36.001 INFO - Creating unsigned block for slot 96683 2024-08-12 20:07:36.007 ERROR - Validator *** Failed to produce block Slot: 96683 Validator: 8e07396 java.lang.IllegalStateException: ExecutionPayloadContext is not provided for production of post-merge block at slot 96683 at tech.pegasys.teku.validator.coordinator.BlockOperationSelectorFactory.setExecutionData(BlockOperationSelectorFactory.java:219) ~[teku-beacon-validator-develop.jar:UNKNOWN+g2d2d17b] at tech.pegasys.teku.validator.coordinator.BlockOperationSelectorFactory.lambda$createSelector$6(BlockOperationSelectorFactory.java:190) ~[teku-beacon-validator-develop.jar:UNKNOWN+g2d2d17b] at java.base/java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture$UniCompose.tryFire(Unknown Source) ~[?:?] at java.base/java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture.postComplete(Unknown Source) ~[?:?] at java.base/java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture.complete(Unknown Source) ~[?:?] at tech.pegasys.teku.infrastructure.async.SafeFuture.lambda$propagateResult$3(SafeFuture.java:147) ~[teku-infrastructure-async-develop.jar:UNKNOWN+g2d2d17b] at java.base/java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture.uniWhenComplete(Unknown Source) ~[?:?] at java.base/java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture.uniWhenCompleteStage(Unknown Source) ~[?:?] at java.base/ ... ``` there's some bugs with prysm's committee logic with EIP7549 changes, perhaps that's what's creating some issues. still working through it. what fork is that running? We did enable v3 block production by default - can turn it off with (`--Xblock-v3-enabled=false`) and see if that improves things? `pectra-devnet-2` canonical. Almost all slots are missed by Teku-Erigon pair recently, is that V3 block production a recent change? yes it was using v2 until a few days ago so we might revert that, but also i need to check the release... Over to you <@199561711278227457> <@412614104222531604> does at least look like the release is correct just closing that off - so we'll chase down why v3 appears to be not happy for electra - ta for heads up <@976542403269910539> `ethpandaops/teku:master-2d2d17b` are we going to need eth_getBlobsV1 for devnet3, and do we have a launch date for devnet 3 yet? blockers for devnet-3, we launch once they're cleared 😄 https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/892088344438255616/1272505625644896296 other teku combos are working so its possibly not related to v3 unless theres different instances running, we'll have to do more digging. I noticed locally it seems to run happily in kurtosis for electra, so that kind of blows the 'v3 block production theory' up just fyi. It looks like erigon occasionally missing with prysm too. Will see if we can replicate misses I guess.
